summary: Answer strict explicit-status RFI/Submittal inventory questions from the complete cached index without retrieval or a model call.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email efficiency, accuracy and adaptability
The user requested Trunk Tools-style questions answered from existing project files
Current source inspection proved that common status-filtered inventory questions still fell through to an eight-passage evidence window and model path
approval_evidence: The persistent objective and project-question request authorize this deterministic completeness, accuracy and cost improvement.
known_limitations: Only strict English count/list forms containing one bounded RFI/Submittal disposition use this path.
A status must apply to every requested workflow type; incompatible combinations stay on the evidence/model path.
A group with multiple distinct explicit statuses is never counted as confirmed even if every phrase could support the broad filter.
Email-derived RFI/Submittal contexts participate, but Email messages do not receive an inferred semantic status.
Confirmed and ambiguous lists each expose at most 50 ordered identifiers while retaining complete totals.
